faq.q: What have houses in Abbotsford East sold for?

items.t: Abbotsford East: 261 houses sold at a median of $1,060,000, with the middle half between $939,900 and $1,285,000. The median house took 23 days to sell and closed at 97.2% of list.

117 townhomes sold in Abbotsford East at a median of $720,000 (middle half $610,000 to $799,900). A typical townhome in Abbotsford East spent 27 days on the market and closed at 98.0% of the asking price.
In Abbotsford East, condos sold at a median of $456,000 across 19 sales, and the middle half closed between $402,500 and $527,500. The median condo sat 13 days and sold for 98.6% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Abbotsford East compares with the rest of Abbotsford

items.t: Houses in Abbotsford East have the third highest median of 7 Abbotsford sub-areas, $1,060,000. Poplar is lowest at $925,000 and Bradner highest at $1,575,000. Abbotsford West ($1,023,564) sits just below and Aberdeen ($1,335,000) sits just above.
Townhomes in Abbotsford East have the highest median of the 5 Abbotsford sub-areas, $720,000, ahead of Aberdeen at $688,500; the lowest is Poplar at $580,000.
Condos in Abbotsford East have the highest median of the 4 Abbotsford sub-areas, $456,000, ahead of Central Abbotsford at $390,000; the lowest is Abbotsford West at $349,900.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Abbotsford East (median 2015) and houses the oldest (median 1993), a gap of 22 years.
